item.title: Codex CLI adds prompt presets, inline settings, enterprise MCP sign-in
item.description:
Tibo announced Codex CLI updates: reusable prompt presets, inline model and permission settings, enterprise MCP sign-in, fixes for resuming long sessions, and Windows corporate-proxy authentication. He also noted CLI usage has doubled since DevDay.
Source text: On codex cli updates. We've added reusable prompt presets, inline model and permission settings, and enterprise MCP sign-in. We've also fixed failures when resuming long sessions and added Windows corporate-proxy authentication.
Surprisingly the CLI has grown 2X in usage since devday.
Source: https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2113770862860222611

item.title: Codex CLI updated; reasoning changes no longer invalidate cache
item.description:
Tibo reports small updates: calls connect faster for dots, changing reasoning mid-conversation in Codex and Work no longer invalidates the cache, and the Codex CLI has been updated.
Source text: Day 19/ Small updates. Calls connect much faster for dots, changing reasoning in codex & work mid conversation does not invalidate cache anymore and a we've also updated the codex cli.
Source: https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2113770573994299544

item.title: Codex and Work keep prompt cache indefinitely
item.description:
Tibo says API users can now cache for 12 hours, while logged-in Codex and Work users keep cache indefinitely with no penalty for resuming old conversations and are now guaranteed to hit the cache.
Source text: Day 16/
You can now cache for 12h in the API and for logged in users across Codex & Work we keep cache forever and you don’t have any penalty for coming back to an old conversation or resuming after a few hours and are now guaranteed to hit the cache. https://t.co/0HYeB01KVh
Source: https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2112712984644784534

item.title: Codex and Work usage improved via context and routing changes
item.description:
Tibo announced that improvements to Codex and Work increase effective usage, achieved by reusing context across subagents, keeping context cached longer, and better request routing for higher cache hits.
Source text: Day 12/
We’ve made improvements to Codex & Work that increase the effective usage you get. We achieved this by reusing context across subagents, keeping context cached longer, and improved request routing that allows us to increase cache hits.
Source: https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2111244596131111253

item.title: Codex desktop disk storage reduced by 60%
item.description:
Tibo announced that optimizations to how the ChatGPT and Codex desktop app stores state on disk have rolled out, expected to cut disk usage by about 60% in response to power-user feedback.
Source text: Day 9/

item.title: Codex default context raised to 500k for GPT-6.1 Sol
item.description:
Tibo announced that the default context length for GPT-6.1 Sol through Codex and Work is now 500k, up from 272k, with a 1M maximum available via override. He said they will go higher in the future.
Source text: Day 7/
We have increased default context length for GPT-6.1 Sol to 500k when used through Codex & Work, up from 272k or an ~ 80% increase.
We will go higher in the future, but it helps reduce occurrence of compactions and with tasks that require keeping a lot of context and nuance over periods of time. It was carefully tested and is the new sweet spot for most of our users. You can still override it if you want to be higher our lower, with maximum context length of GPT-6.1 Sol of 1M.
Source: https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2109430343346581527

item.title: Tibo says the reset has been processed
item.description:
Tibo states that after community demand and his own calibration, "the reset has been processed," framing it as completed rather than planned.
Source text: We shipped four things that were deemed good to great and some math proofs, but the vote is clear and the community demands a reset. I did calibrate it and it *seems* that the game is rigged in reset's favor, but such are the rules at the moment.
Therefore ... the reset has been processed. Enjoy!
Source: https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2107676072871600470
